findings.current: The thirteen-year-old Prince Shangshan had already proved on his own that he could do what even adults who’d done nothing but age with the time handed to them could not.
findings.defect: Shangshan says he is twelve in Chapter 872, and both speakers refer to him as twelve earlier in Chapter 873.
findings.rationale: Keeps the narration consistent with his stated age.
findings.replacement: The twelve-year-old Prince Shangshan had already proved on his own that he could do what even adults who’d done nothing but age with the time handed to them could not.
findings.source: Chapter 873, Taekyung’s assessment of Prince Shangshan

findings.current: After wiping Samyeong’s blood from my face, I stepped in front of Prince Shangshan, who was breathing in short, shallow gasps.
findings.defect: Samyeong is an unmapped romanization of the assassin called Third Shadow throughout the scene.
findings.rationale: Uses the established rendering at a moment when the assassin’s identity matters.
findings.replacement: After wiping Third Shadow’s blood from my face, I stepped in front of Prince Shangshan, who was breathing in short, shallow gasps.
findings.source: Chapter 873, immediately after Third Shadow’s execution

findings.current: Are you saying you really don’t know, or that you know but won’t tell me?
findings.defect: The line lacks the dash marking Sound Transmission, although Jeong immediately answers it through Sound Transmission.
findings.rationale: Makes the exchange legible without implying Jeong answered an unspoken thought.
findings.replacement: —Are you saying you really don’t know, or that you know but won’t tell me?
findings.source: Chapter 871, Taekyung’s exchange with Jeong Hogun

findings.current: He threw open the door before them, decorated with gold, silver, and jewels, without the slightest hesitation, then spoke.
findings.defect: The first-person narration slips into “them,” and the modifier makes it unclear whether the door or the people are decorated.
findings.rationale: Restores Taekyung’s viewpoint and makes the decoration attach clearly to the door.
findings.replacement: Without the slightest hesitation, he threw open the door before us, decorated with gold, silver, and jewels, then spoke.
findings.source: Chapter 871, entrance to the Emperor’s bedchamber

findings.current: Was this the same “brother-in-law” as the one who’d married your wife’s older sister?
findings.defect: The kinship explanation does not support the following joke about Jeong Hogun being transgender: it describes the wife’s sister rather than the speaker’s older sister.
findings.rationale: Makes the English setup lead into Taekyung’s next thought.
findings.replacement: Was this the same “brother-in-law” a woman would call her older sister’s husband?
findings.source: Chapter 870, Taekyung’s Ministry of Punishments wordplay

summary: The packet largely maintains its voice and continuity. The actionable issues are an age contradiction, a name drift, a missing Sound Transmission marker, and two localized prose errors.
